ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a macro-ratio of approximately 95:5; high-intensity pixels are isolated to localized circular scars and edge highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Absence of large contiguous geometric blobs; spatial mapping consists of discrete, high-contrast white ring-shaped pixel clusters and irregular stippling distributed across the medial and distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with variable pixel amplitudes; distal regions of both lobes exhibit significant jaggedness with irregular peak intervals, particularly on the right lobe distal third.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed sigmoidal curve; exhibiting initial concavity at the median notch, transitioning to a convex mid-lobe sweep, and tapering to acute terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread mapping of high-contrast circular rings (rosette scars) distributed across the entire visible ventral surface; spatial density is highest on the medial distal region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent horizontal high-intensity linear mark on the proximal left lobe; several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible on the central-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive live barnacle clusters attached to the extreme distal tips of both lobes; distinct semi-circular indentation (likely traumatic notch) on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced terminal surface texture provided by protruding barnacle colonizations at the fluke tips, which break the continuous geometric contour of the trailing edge.
